blocks.orig: Chanya in Kiswahili translates to ‘positive’. Chanya Lodge is nestled on the outskirts of Moshi town, at the foothills of the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro and just a 50-minute drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport, making it an ideal stay for trekkers, safari seekers and families. Guests are warmly welcomed by the smiles of friendly, helpful staff and accommodated in one of 32 ensuite, well equipped and cozy rooms. The lodge is known for its abundant green gardens, multi-cuisine restaurant and its large swimming pool.
blocks.html: In Kiswahili, chanya means ‘positive’. Chanya Lodge lies on the edge of Moshi town, at the foot of the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro and only a 50-minute drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport, which makes it a great place to stay for trekkers, safari travellers and families. The friendly, helpful staff greet you with warm smiles, and you stay in one of 32 cosy, well-equipped ensuite rooms. The lodge is known for its lush green gardens, its restaurant serving many cuisines and its large swimming pool.
